project_type: FastAPI + React TypeScript - Football Intelligence Platform
build_system: Python with pip/virtualenv, no frontend build in this phase
verification_instructions: Run pytest for new provider test modules. No real network calls in tests - all use mocked httpx responses. Tests verify: capability detection logic, health status mapping, normalization with spatial fields, API response structure.
environment_constraints: use_real_providers=False by default (keep this). Never expose secrets in logs. Do not activate providers globally. SofaScore base_url not in config yet - will be added. Ryzellx returns 402 Payment Required. FotMob /api/matches returns 404. OpenLigaDB xg=None always (authoritative).
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: always inspect files before editing, work in small verifiable steps, run tests after implementation, never claim working without verification, never fabricate data (REAL DATA > NULL > FABRICATED DATA), update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion.
key_patterns: Provider classes: async methods, httpx.AsyncClient, retry logic, normalization to ProviderXxx models with source metadata. ProviderManager: routing by operation type (LIVE_ORDER, MATCH_DETAIL_ORDER, etc.), source-of-truth rule (one provider per response). Exception hierarchy: ProviderError base with TimeoutError, HTTPError, InvalidDataError, NotFoundError. Models: Pydantic BaseModel with provider/source_id/fetched_at/is_live/data_freshness_seconds. Tests: pytest with mocked httpx, no real network.
directory_structure: backend/app/providers/ (provider implementations), backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/ (REST endpoints), backend/tests/ (test files), docs/ (documentation)
